description: This file defines a color theme for the Streamly TV experience using Jetpack Compose. It includes a data class 'TvColors' that maps CSS-like design tokens to Compose Color values, a default color palette 'DefaultTvColors', and utility objects/values for theming support.

classes.name: TvColors
classes.description: Data class that encapsulates color properties for the theme, mapping design tokens into Compose Color objects.

methods.name: StreamlyColors.default
methods.description: Provides access to the default color theme for the Streamly TV experience.
